Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this. As part of WaveLine Health's vendor intake we need the following to progress to our security review board: a current subprocessor roster (names/roles, country residency), your completed SIG/CAIQ responses (redactions are fine for irrelevant internal IP), and a simple deployment dataflow diagram showing where customer data traverses (we can accept a PNG). We also need a signed SOC 2 statement or SCC reference if available.

Can you confirm whether:
- You can provide a CSV roster with residency and purpose-of-access for each subprocessor?
- SIG/CAIQ answers can be delivered as a PDF bundle?
- Transfer via an encrypted SFTP drop or a pre-signed cloud link is preferred?

Our timeline: decision committee meets next Thursday (2027-03-25), so if we can get artifacts by EOD Friday (2027-03-19) that would be ideal. Also: please indicate which subprocessors have access to request-level telemetry or token-level logs.

Thanks,
Elena Cruz
Security Operations Manager
WaveLine Health

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can package what you requested. Quick outline and confirmations: 

1) Subprocessor roster: we will provide a CSV with name, company, role/purpose-of-access, country of operation, and whether they are onshore/on-prem or cloud. Filename: redwood_subprocessor_roster_v1.csv (stub attached).

2) SIG/CAIQ: we will deliver a PDF bundle with our current SIG answers and a CAIQ mapping sheet (XLSX). We will sanitize internal IP in attachments; anything sensitive will be redacted. Files: redwood_SIG_responses_v1.pdf, caIQ-matrix_redwood.xlsx.

3) Dataflow diagram: we will include an anonymized PNG showing inference request flow + KMS boundary: dataflow_inference_redwood.png (sanitized).

4) SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report; because of sensitivity we provide the SOC 2 via secure share under NDA/TOU — we can include a SOC attestation statement in the bundle and then provide axis-of-trust procedures for the full report.

5) Transfer: we prefer a pre-signed cloud link (time-bound) but can also do SFTP. If you prefer SFTP, please provide endpoint + contact for credential exchange.

6) Access to telemetry/logs: we will annotate the CSV to indicate which subprocessors have access to tokenized logs or aggregated telemetry. Short answer: only our telemetry ingestion partner (OnBoard Analytics) has access for aggregation; engineering support contractors have scoped, read-only access to ephemeral traces for debugging under strict RBAC and logged sessions. We'll mark this in the roster.

We can deliver the bundle by EOD 2027-03-19. If that works, I'll follow up with a secure link and audit snapshot keys.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
